title: Cleanup Crew
briefing: A body in a studio apartment, ruled a probable overdose by the first responders. Something's off - the scene is immaculate. Too immaculate. The ME, Lena Park, flagged it for you personally before signing anything.

evidence.name: Injection site (wrong arm)
evidence.description: Injection in the right arm; the victim was right-handed. Inconsistent with self-administration.

evidence.name: Tox screen (pending)
evidence.description: Results take in-game time. May land after you must decide.

evidence.name: Wiped surfaces
evidence.description: Every surface professionally cleaned. Nobody lives this clean.

evidence.name: Staged paraphernalia
evidence.description: Drug kit arranged too neatly - placed, not used. Matches the staging seen in Case 14.

evidence.name: Last texts
evidence.description: Victim arranged to meet someone about 'making it right' the night he died.

evidence.name: Recovered deleted thread
evidence.description: Deleted messages reference a debt owed to people who 'clean up their own messes.'

evidence.name: CCTV gap
evidence.description: Exactly 9 minutes of corridor footage is missing - deliberately, not a glitch.

evidence.name: Figure on the stairwell
evidence.description: A large man leaving via the stairs at the edge of the gap. Face obscured; build matches Boone.

evidence.name: Neighbor's account
evidence.description: Neighbor 'heard the victim was into bad stuff.' Steers you toward the overdose story. Unreliable.

suspects.name: "Boone"
suspects.motive: Contract cleanup - silenced the victim over a debt and staged the scene as an overdose.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was never there. The stairwell footage says otherwise.

suspects.name: Local dealer (Reyes's tip)
suspects.motive: Obvious scapegoat - the overdose story points here.
suspects.alibi: Was in county lockup that night, verifiable.

nodes.speaker_line: Never been to that address. You've got the wrong guy.
So I was in the building. Doesn't make me a killer. Guy used. Everybody knew.

options.text: He was right-handed. The needle's in the wrong arm.
Nobody cleans a place like this by accident.

nodes.speaker_line: ...I do a job. I don't ask questions and I don't keep names. That's the whole point.
A voice. A number that's dead now. You think people like me ever meet people like him? Good luck, detective.

options.text: Book him. The rest is a thread for later.

solution.correct_motive: Contract killing staged as an overdose; Boone was hired anonymously to silence the victim and clean the scene.
